articles.title: Nifty slips below 22,800 as rising oil prices, US yields trigger selling

articles.title: Russia hits Ukraine's largest mobile provider, strikes data centres
articles.summary: Russia recently struck Kyivstar's headquarters, Ukraine's largest mobile provider, as part of a continued bombardment targeting Ukrainian data centers and communication infrastructure. This systematic campaign aims to disrupt essential services nationwide. Such attacks highlight the hybrid warfare dimension, impacting crucial civilian infrastructure vital for daily life and national resilience amid the ongoing conflict.
